tasks.subject: Task 0: Project skeleton
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Repo has venv, dependency manifest, gitignore, and a runnable stub.

**Files:** requirements.txt, .gitignore, claude_tap.py (stub), README.md

**Verify:** `.venv/bin/python claude_tap.py` -> prints `claude-tap starting`, exit 0.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["requirements.txt", ".gitignore", "claude_tap.py", "README.md"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/python claude_tap.py", "acceptanceCriteria": ["venv installs cleanly", "stub runs and exits 0", ".venv ignored"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: HID discovery + lizard mode disable
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Daemon finds the Steam Controller via HIDAPI, opens it, disables lizard mode, and prints raw 64-byte input reports.

**Files:** claude_tap.py

**Verify:** Run daemon, tap A and B, confirm hex output differs.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["claude_tap.py"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/python claude_tap.py", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Steam Controller enumerated", "device opened", "lizard mode disabled", "A vs B produce different hex"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Button bitmap parser (unit-tested)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pure function parse_buttons(report_bytes) -> set[str]. Unit-tested against captured fixtures.

**Files:** claude_tap.py, tests/__init__.py, tests/test_button_parser.py

**Verify:** `.venv/bin/pytest tests/ -v` -> all tests pass.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["claude_tap.py", "tests/__init__.py", "tests/test_button_parser.py"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/pytest tests/ -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["A fixture returns {A}", "B fixture returns {B}", "idle returns set()", "tests pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Edge detection + tmux send-keys
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Detect press edges, resolve tmux target via window-name -x suffix, send digit via tmux send-keys.

**Files:** claude_tap.py

**Verify:** Rename a window to test-x, run cat in it, tap A -> 1 appears.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["claude_tap.py"], "verifyCommand": "manual: tap A in a tmux window named *-x", "acceptanceCriteria": ["A -> 1", "B -> 2", "edge-triggered", "no -x window drops silently"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Reconnect on disconnect/sleep
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Daemon survives controller sleep, laptop sleep, and Bluetooth toggle.

**Files:** claude_tap.py

**Verify:** Toggle BT off and on. Watch logs. Tap A -> 1 lands.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["claude_tap.py"], "verifyCommand": "manual: toggle bluetooth, tap A", "acceptanceCriteria": ["survives BT toggle", "reconnect logged", "post-reconnect taps work"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: launchd integration + bootstrap
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Daemon auto-starts at login, restarts on crash, logs to ~/Library/Logs/claude-tap.log.

**Files:** launchd/com.hugh.claude-tap.plist, bootstrap.sh, README.md

**Verify:** ./bootstrap.sh, then launchctl list | grep claude-tap shows loaded. Tap A -> 1.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["launchd/com.hugh.claude-tap.plist", "bootstrap.sh", "README.md"], "verifyCommand": "./bootstrap.sh && launchctl list | grep claude-tap", "acceptanceCriteria": ["bootstrap succeeds", "agent loaded", "auto-start at login", "logs land in ~/Library/Logs/claude-tap.log"]}
```
